title: Hermes Context Engineering OS
purpose: Turn Context Engineering into a governed Hermes context runtime: objective, sources, evidence, memory/profile, skills, tools/authority, execution, and verification.
red_lines: No external dispatch, deploy, push, credential entry, destructive cleanup, scheduler/worker enablement, or task lifecycle mutation without exact target, rollback/readback, and explicit authority.
Do not store WIP/progress in durable memory; use SSOT/task evidence/session transcript.
Do not reduce Context Engineering to vector RAG or long-context dumping.
